system.description:
You know how to get exactly where you need to be, when you need to be there.

Powers/Qualities

Assign one of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to the @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle} power or a power from the Mobility category. If you already have at least one, either skip it or swap this die with one of your new dice.

Assign one or more remaining dice to any of these powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Mobility powers category

• Select from Psychic powers category

• Select from Technological powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• Select from Physical qualities category

• Select from Social qualities category

Abilities

Gain two of the following Green abilities, using two different powers.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.YRedgGF4MwRihDPh]{Displacement Assault}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.5OtnGe7R4OoOjfck]{Hit & Run}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.m1MJKmpisIGMKatS]{Mobile Assist}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.s1cfEPIftrbKiRv5]{Mobile Dodge}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.QrX70BABFgW8K5q4]{Run Down}

Gain one of the above abilities as a Yellow ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.QqU1ALV6yCPxFAdq]{Displacement Assault}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.RAOrs4cIuVH8WNCv]{Hit & Run}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.jgsx052iAprqogaC]{Mobile Assist}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.i5MSZbAhwHhFovFt]{Mobile Dodge}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.0afn9nJrtrdEU3ox]{Run Down}
Principle

Choose an Expertise principle.

Personality

Roll d10, d10 for personality selection.
